purpose: Rank 2, W-SPREAD-CELL1: batched hourly candle requests (up to 55 tickers each) over the 1041 SPREAD events never scored.
heldout: W-SPREAD-CELL1: one pooled out-of-sample block read once after the pull is complete; the 360 events of W-CAT-SPORTS1 are excluded and its newest third stays unread
notes: Batching as spread_pull2.py: events sorted by (max close, event); a batch holds up to 110 tickers and events whose close is within 2 days of the batch's first event; each batch is sent as requests of up to 55 tickers; window per batch is min close minus 5 days to max close plus 3600 s, period_interval 60. Fields the reader keeps: end_period_ts, yes_ask close, yes_bid close, price close, volume. Source list (frozen, on the refine-live branch): kalshi-scalper/refine_tools/SPREAD_CELL1_EVENTS.json.

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal
